ads.alt: Photo of a man's bare shoulder with a copper-toned LESPIRANT L-Cut undershirt worn open at the front. Text reads: No Sweat Stains. No Collar. Invisible, even under a thin white shirt. I want my L-Cut.
Close-up photo of the TENCEL fabric swing tag pinned to a copper L-Cut undershirt. Text reads: TENCEL Fabric. Softer Than Cotton. Sweat-wicking, odor-resistant, 100% Made in EU. I want my L-Cut.
Three flat-lay product photos of the L-Cut undershirt in its Nude, Copper, and Maroon colorways side by side. Text reads: 3 Skin Tones. Always Invisible. Nude, Copper, Maroon. I want my L-Cut.
Photo of seamstresses sewing garments in LESPIRANT's EU workshop. Text reads: 100% Made in EU. Living wages, health insurance, fair trade. Sustainability.

Banner with four photos of a man opening his dress shirt over a taupe LESPIRANT L-Cut undershirt, seen from the front, back and side. Text reads: The undershirt, evolved. The most breatheable undershirt ever designed! I want my L-Cut.

Banner with six rooftop photos of a man putting on a copper L-Cut undershirt and buttoning a patterned shirt over it. Text reads: Step 1: put it on. Step 2: forget it exists. Keeps stain free, fresh, and sharp looking. I want my L-Cut.

Banner with a photo of a man in a copper L-Cut undershirt holding his open dress shirt, standing against a bright yellow painted wall. Text reads: Your dress shirt's new bodyguard. No sweat marks, no deodorant stains, no collar. I want my L-Cut.

Banner comparing torsos in white dress shirts: on the left, a nude L-Cut undershirt that disappears under the shirt; on the right, two ordinary undershirts showing through, each crossed out in red. Text reads: White shirt. Zero evidence. Invisible even under thin white shirts - No overheating. I want my L-Cut. Discover the L-Cut and forget your dad's undershirts.

Banner with a labelled diagram of the L-Cut undershirt between two photos of a man wearing one under an open shirt. The labels call out slanted sleeves, an open front, flat seams, a floating back, Tencel fabric, 100% Made in EU and 3 skin tones. Text reads: The best undershirt is invisible and cool to wear. No collar. No overheating. No sweat stains. I want my L-Cut.

Banner showing the L-Cut undershirt flat-laid in Nude, Copper and Maroon above three close-ups of sweat-stained shirts, each crossed out in red. Text reads: 3 Skin Tones. Always Invisible. Nude, Copper, Maroon. No collar. No sweat stains. No overheating. I want my L-Cut.
